verdict.rationale: Kling documents native audio co-generation of sound effects and ambient sound alongside video from Kling 2.6 onward. Pricing lists 'with audio' generation tiers, so scene-matched audio is produced in the same tool rather than added with an external one. missing for 10: evidence of music generation, in-depth documentation of how audio is matched to scene content or how it can be controlled, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Native audio co-generation (speech, sound effects, ambient sound) introduced in Kling 2.6 (December 2025)
